title: The left-pigeon bound re-derived and audited
claim: Audit of WIDE-LEFT-20261110-001A's Theorem (W). Re-derived from Braun's stated results (arXiv 2609.23015) with every constant explicit: every dag-like Res(xor) refutation of the 2n-pigeon formula WLP_n (Pudlak and Thapen's rWPHP_n) has 3S + 2n^2(l+1) >= exp(0.005 k / l^2), k = floor(n/(64 l^3)), l >= 20, and so does every refutation of the binary left-pigeon principle LP_{n+1} (a clause subset). Every step survives four adversarial reviews (spare-row lemma, density count, reduction and transfer, literature); the eight results of Braun's it uses are all in the import closure replayed in a fresh kernel by BPHP-RES-PARITY-AUDIT-20261019-001A, with Lean statements that cover the uses. Not new in substance: exp(Omega(n)) for both formulas follows from Pang's degree-size relation (arXiv 2610.00837, Cor. 1.3 and Thm 7.2) by the affine substitution into graph FPHP; the bit-PHP corollary is in Pang and ECCC TR26-316.
failure_conditions: A step of the re-derivation that does not hold as stated (the transfer, the reduction, the spare-row lemma, the density count), found by the author or a reviewer.
A Lean statement of a cited result of Braun's whose hypotheses do not cover the use (for example m = 2n rows, or a cube with hole coordinates).
A known refutation of the 2n-pigeon or n + 1 pigeon formula, in dag-like Res(xor) or a system it simulates, shorter than the bound.
foundation_claim_scope: Proof complexity of the binary left-pigeon principle (with n + 1 and with 2n pigeons) in dag-like Res(xor); nothing about the knot sphere's count.

validation.independence: Re-derived by Claude, the author of WIDE-LEFT-20261110-001A, on 2026-11-10; attacked by fresh Claude reviewers that were not shown the proof (same model, so not independent in the V2 sense).
validation.status: re-derived by hand; numeric checks in check.py (rewritten independently); attacked by four fresh same-model reviewers with their own code; no failing step; one presentation gap in the earlier Lemma 2 (redundant side conditions) noted
validation.novelty: not new in substance: the formula is Pudlak-Thapen's rWPHP_n, and a stronger exp(Omega(n)) bound follows from Pang (arXiv 2610.00837, 30 September 2026) in a few lines; corrections logged in docs/CORRECTIONS.md on 2026-11-10
